stages.product: a downward push on the long arm
stages.less: a much weaker push on the long arm
stages.does: a worker pushes down on the long arm of the lever
stages.why: the push is the effort that the lever will multiply

stages.text: The lever at {E} turns on a sturdy pivot, so its short arm presses down hard on a board above the apples.
stages.tag: the lever turning on its pivot
stages.from: a downward push on the long arm
stages.product: a strong squeeze on the apples
stages.less: a much weaker squeeze on the apples

stages.why: turning on the pivot turns a modest push into a strong squeeze
stages.needWhy: the lever can only multiply the worker's push if it turns freely on its pivot
stages.cause: What allows the press at {E} to squeeze the apples hard?

cases.event: One week, workers at {E} found that their fictional lever press needed a much harder push than usual.
cases.q: What most likely made the lever press at {E} harder to push?
restate: The lever press at {E} became harder to push, and the question asks why.
Something made the lever press at {E} need a harder push.
cases.answer: Moving the pivot closer to the handle most likely made the press harder to push, because it shortened the arm the workers push on.
cases.sum: the evidence points to moving the pivot as the reason the press was harder to push.
cases.myth: The press at {E} became harder to push because the lever grew heavier overnight.
cases.mythClause: the press was hard to push only when it rained
cases.altText: Some workers suggested that the apples at {E} had become harder and less ripe.
cases.patternQ: What pattern connects the position of the pivot and the push needed at {E}?
cases.patternA: The press became hard to push after the pivot was moved and became easy again once the pivot was put back, so the push followed the position of the pivot.
cases.patternSum: the press was hard to push while the pivot was moved and easy to push once it was put back.

prediction.text: Early that week, a worker predicted that the press would become easy to push again once the apples ripened.
prediction.claim: the press at {E} would become easy to push once the apples ripened
prediction.whyNot: the press was hard to push even with no apples in it

cases.observerNote: The workers wrote down how the press felt after every batch.

obs.text: The extra effort began the day after a repair crew put the lever back on a new pivot pin.
exps: the problem started right after the pivot was changed, which points to the repair
the timing ties the harder push to the repair, not to the apples
a change that appears the day after a repair suggests the repair caused it

obs.text: Measurements showed that the pivot was now {n0} centimeters closer to the handle than before.
obs.tag: the new position of the pivot
exps: a pivot closer to the handle shortens the arm the workers push on, so they need more force
this shows how the push got harder, since a shorter long arm multiplies the push less
moving the pivot toward the handle takes away the lever's advantage

obs.text: When the crew moved the pivot back to its old spot, the press felt easy to push again within a day.
obs.tag: the press after the pivot was moved back
exps: the press became easy again once the pivot was restored, which is what would happen if the pivot were the cause
fixing the pivot fixed the problem, so the two are linked
once the cause was undone, the effect disappeared

obs.text: The apples came from the same trees and were just as ripe as the week before.
exps: the apples did not change, so they cannot explain why the press changed
this rules out the apples, because they were just as ripe as before
with the apples unchanged, the apple explanation has nothing to stand on

obs.text: Pressing an empty board, with no apples at all, also took a harder push than before.
exps: if hard apples were the cause, the press would feel normal with no apples, but it did not
this rules out the apples, since the problem remained without them
a hard push with nothing in the press points to the lever itself
predExps: this directly contradicts the prediction, since the press was hard to push even with no apples
if riper apples would fix the problem, the press would be easy with no apples at all, but it was not
the prediction blamed the apples, but the problem stayed when the apples were gone
